summary: The customer called regarding a defective boAt Airdopes earbud received six days ago. The agent informed her that the return and warranty claim window had expired, offering no replacement or refund. The customer remained dissatisfied and stated she would contact the brand directly.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopEase. My name is Imran Sheikh. Please note that this call is recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Imran, I am Neha Sethi. I bought boAt Airdopes six days ago and the left earbud is completely dead. I want to know what I can do.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sorry to hear that, Ms. Sethi. For verification, please share your Order ID and the last four digits of your registered mobile number.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. So the left earbud of your boAt Airdopes stopped working and you want a solution. Correct?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that is right. It never worked since I opened the box.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. Unfortunately, any defect has to be reported within 48 hours of delivery with photos, and since you are on day six, there is nothing we can do. No replacement, no return and no warranty claim is possible now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No warranty at all? The box says one year warranty.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Warranty covers only six months for audio products, and it is void if you did not claim in the first two days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That cannot be right. Can I at least return it? It is only day six.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am sorry, that is our policy and I cannot do anything. Is there anything else?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that is not helpful at all. I will check with the brand directly.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You can do that. Thank you for calling ShopEase, have a nice day.
